text: {"lessons":["I sold 25 shares of Stock A at a gain, and locking in that profit felt satisfying; I should still base future sell decisions on my plan, not just the pleasure of realizing a gain.","My account fell 4.2% in Period 4 after rising in earlier periods; short-term swings are uncomfortable, but past price changes do not predict what comes next.","Because losses weigh heavily on me, I should watch for reluctance to sell a losing position or eagerness to sell a winner, and evaluate each holding consistently."]}
